entities.summary: Gulzhan Moldazhanova is a Kazakh businesswoman who was CEO for Basic Element, and was named among the most powerful women of the mid- to late 2000s. In 2018, she and others resigned from the Russian company Rusal as it was facing sanctions from the US.
